high_level_description: The image depicts a woman sitting on a stone ledge by the River Thames in London, England. She is wearing a red strapless top and denim shorts, with her long, wavy hair cascading down her back. She has a tattoo on her left arm and is accessorized with a necklace, earrings, and a bracelet on her right wrist. Her left hand rests on the ledge, while her right hand is placed on her thigh. In the background, the iconic architecture of the Palace of Westminster is prominently featured, including the Elizabeth Tower (commonly known as Big Ben) and the Houses of Parliament.
